author: admin
title: Mid-semester exam timetable is out
body:
The mid-semester timetable for all programs is now on the notice boards in every block and on the student portal.

Exams start Monday. Carry your college ID to every paper. Seating plans go up one day before each exam.

author: rkulkarni
title: Deep Learning lab moved to Lab 3, Block A this Friday
body: Third-year AIML: Friday's Deep Learning lab will be in Lab 3, Block A (ground floor) because Lab 1 is under maintenance. Same time, 2:00 PM. Bring your notebooks from last week.

author: lmenon
title: Central library open till 10 PM during exam weeks
body: The central library reading hall stays open until 10:00 PM from Monday to Saturday for the next three weeks. Silent zones on the first floor.

author: admin
title: Pre-placement talk: data analyst roles, Thursday 11 AM
body: Final-year students from CSE, AIML, DS, and IT: a pre-placement talk for data analyst roles is on Thursday at 11:00 AM in the Seminar Hall, Block A. Formal dress. Attendance is mandatory for registered students.

author: miyer
title: DBMS assignment 2 deadline extended to Monday
body: Second-year CSE: assignment 2 (normalization) is now due Monday 11:59 PM. Submit on the portal as a single PDF.

author: sneha
title: Build with AI: hands-on workshop
body:
Bring your laptop and build a small app with a public AI API in 3 hours. Beginners welcome, no ML background needed. Snacks on us.

What you'll learn:
- Calling an AI API from a web app
- Prompting basics
- Deploying for free

author: sneha
title: Flutter study jam: build your first app
body: Two-hour study jam. We'll build a to-do app in Flutter step by step. Install Flutter before you come (guide in comments).

title: Robotics Expo 2026: line followers, drones, and a sumo bot fight
body: Come see what the club built this semester. Open to everyone. Try driving the sumo bots yourself.

author: aarav
title: Why is 3NF not always dependency preserving?
body: In the example from class, decomposing R(A, B, C, D) with A -> B, B -> C, C -> D seems to lose B -> C after the second split. I thought 3NF always preserves dependencies. What am I missing?

author: vikram
title: Why do we multiply by the derivative of the activation in backprop?
body: I get the chain rule in general, but in the backprop equations why does sigma prime of z show up at every layer? Isn't the loss only a function of the output?

author: kabir
title: Difference between deadlock prevention and avoidance?
body: Both sound like 'make sure deadlock never happens'. What's the actual difference? Is Banker's algorithm prevention or avoidance?

author: g-bca-1-01
title: Why does my pointer print garbage after the function returns?
body: I return the address of a local array from a function and print it in main. First element is fine, rest are random numbers. Why?

author: riya
title: When should I use median instead of mean?
body: For the assignment on household income data, which one should I report as the 'typical' value, and how do I justify it?

author: neha
title: Can a K-map group wrap around the corners?
body: In a 4-variable K-map, can the four corner cells be grouped together as one quad?

author: g-mech-2-01
title: Is entropy change zero for every adiabatic process?
body: Our notes say adiabatic means no heat transfer, so dS = dQ/T = 0. But the tutorial answer says entropy increases in an irreversible adiabatic process. Which is right?

author: aarav
title: What do eigenvectors actually mean geometrically?
body: I can compute them but I don't get the intuition. Why are they important for PCA?

author: admin
title: Welcome to Campus Connect: how to get started
body:
1. Complete your profile so classmates and faculty can find you.
2. Join clubs and interest communities.
3. Ask doubts, post requests, and report lost items.
4. Use the Directory to find any faculty cabin.

Use the report option if you see something that doesn't belong here.
